The '''Yi'Tsarin River Canyon''' was a large [[river]] [[canyon]] located on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It crossed the [[Akazi Plains]] and, as its name implies, the [[Yi'Tsarin River]] flowed through the canyon.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Yi'Tsarin River Canyon was one of many designated [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
